home.title: Share private GitHub repositories | share.git
home.description: Share private GitHub repositories through short, read-only links without personal access tokens or viewer accounts, with open source self-hosting available

ui.heading: Share a private GitHub repository
ui.intro: Sign in with the GitHub App to create a read-only link that lets recipients browse your files, branches, and commits without a GitHub account
ui.staysPrivate: Your repo stays private on GitHub
ui.accessWarning: Anyone with this link can read every branch and its history, while removing the repository from the GitHub App installation stops future access but cannot recall downloaded content
ui.help: You must administer this repository, install the GitHub App on it, and then sign in to create a link
ui.noPat: No personal access tokens collected or stored
ui.browseThis: Browse this repository if it's public
ui.invalidRepository: Enter a GitHub repository URL or owner/repo
ui.clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard access is unavailable, so select and copy the link below
ui.readOnlyDescription: Give someone read-only access to files, branches, and commit history without granting permission to change the repository
ui.appDescription: Sign in with a GitHub App scoped to your selected repositories without ever pasting or storing a personal access token
ui.expiryDescription: Links expire after seven days and let recipients open the code in their browser without creating an account or joining your repository
ui.stepOneDescription: Paste a GitHub URL or use the owner/repo shortcut, then install the GitHub App on the repository you want to share
ui.stepTwo: Sign in and create a link
ui.stepTwoDescription: Sign in as a repository admin so share.git can check your access and create a short, read-only link that expires in seven days
ui.stepThreeDescription: Copy the link into a message, review request, or project handoff so recipients can browse the code without a GitHub account
ui.shortcutDescription: Replace github.com with {domain} in an owner/repository URL to open the sharing form with that repository filled in
ui.shortcutWarning: The shortcut only prepares the form because an authorised admin must still create the private share link
ui.shortcutNote: Opening this shortcut does not create a share
ui.reviewsDescription: Ask a trusted developer to explore an implementation without adding them as a repository collaborator
ui.handoffsDescription: Give a client or teammate a browser view of the project while they review the code and documentation
ui.learningDescription: Share a practice project with a mentor or study partner so you can browse the files and talk through the decisions together
ui.trustWarning: Share only with people you trust because a link opens the entire repository, including its branches and history
ui.openSourceDescription: Licensed under MIT, share.git lets you inspect and adapt the code while keeping control of your domain, GitHub App, deployment, and credentials
